definitions.meaning: The anniversary of a person's ordination

quotations.old_english: Þá gelamp hit embe geáres ryne þ-bar; hit wæs þæs abbodes hádingdæg. Þá sende ánne brððor tó Pafnuntie and laþode hine tó þǽre symbelnesse

source_text: hádung-dæg, es; m. The anniversary of a person's ordination :-- Þá gelamp hit embe geáres ryne þ-bar; hit wæs þæs abbodes hádingdæg. Þá sende ánne brððor tó Pafnuntie and laþode hine tó þǽre symbelnesse, Hml. S. 33, 59. Hádungdæg, 91.
